note.announcementTitle: Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Update On Joint Venture Agreement With Faurecia Automotive Seating India Private Limited
note.headline: Faurecia-Gabriel seating JV formally incorporated; Faurecia holds nominal control (50%+1 share) on an initial Rs20cr tranche
thesisChain: Gabriel India and Faurecia Automotive Seating India incorporate 'Faurecia Anand Seating India Pvt Ltd' on 19-Oct-2026, completing the JVA first disclosed 6-Oct-2026

Faurecia subscribes 50%+1 share (Rs10.00cr) vs Gabriel's 50%-1 share (Rs9.99cr) of an initial Rs20cr paid-up tranche, giving Faurecia nominal board/voting control of the JV rather than a true 50-50 structure
Initial capital call is a small fraction of Gabriel's balance sheet and of the full JV commitment flagged earlier, so near-term P&L impact is immaterial
No EPS impact is derivable until the JV scales seating production and wins OEM business, likely FY28 onward

epsImpact.magnitude: immaterial at the Rs20cr initial tranche relative to Gabriel's scale

note.insight: This is a formal exchange filing (Regulation 30 disclosure) and is a FOLLOW-UP, not new strategic information -- the JVA itself was already flagged on 6-Oct-2026 at 'high' significance. What is new today: the JV company 'Faurecia Anand Seating India Pvt Ltd' was formally incorporated on 19-Oct-2026, and the actual subscription split shows Faurecia holding 50%+1 share (Rs10.00cr paid-up) against Gabriel's 50%-1 share (Rs9.99cr) of an initial Rs20cr tranche -- a nominal-control JV for Faurecia rather than the strictly equal 50-50 structure the earlier headline implied. The amount involved is small relative to Gabriel's size, so shareholder impact today is limited to confirming execution is on track; the strategic read (access to Faurecia's global OEM seating platform) is unchanged from the 6-Oct note. Watch for the first OEM sourcing/order-win announcement out of the JV, which is the point this starts to matter for EPS.
